text:
Sophie: Quick sync for tonight's Rooftop + webinar combo. A few moving parts: EU swag stuck at customs, keynote speaker flight canceled, live demo routing, and lead capture flows. Can everyone ack their pieces?

Nina: Ack. I'm handling attendee comms + webinar join link. Switching to pre-recorded keynote + live panel if speaker can't join. Draft email queued: https://drive.redwood/events/rooftop/comm-draft.

Tom: Confirmed webinar stream + backup RTMP ready. Will run a 5-min pre-record loop before start. Need final pre-record by 17:30. Who's owning the recorded file?

Ravi: I have the pre-record raw and can prod edit; uploading MP4 to drive at 17:00. Also created short benchmark one-pager for tabletop: "5x lower per-token cost vs baseline with batching" with callouts. Feedback welcome.

Amanda: Swag update: pallet delayed in Rotterdam, customs hold ID CUST-89Z. ETA uncertain (customs requested invoice clarification). Shipping team sent docs; customs agent wants HS codes for textiles. If not cleared by 18:00 we switch to digital swag codes + extra postcards.

Sophie: If customs delay persists, let's pivot to: (1) 200 digital discount codes (20% off Redwood Dedicated trial) printed on postcards, (2) extra sticker rolls we have in NYC office, (3) eco-lanyards ordered same-day from local vendor. @Amanda prioritize digital codes.

Amanda: On it. Generating 200 unique codes in Stripe -> exporting CSV -> printing on postcards tonight. ETA printing 19:00. Local lanyards vendor confirmed 50 units.

CJ: Demo ops: switching demo runner to quantized-sm model to keep GPU fan noise down. Demo env: `demo-rooftop` on dedicated pool. I'll rotate API key per session. Also bringing battery pack for hotspot.

Tom: For the webinar: stream key in 1Password label `web-rooftop-2026`. Nina will moderate live Q&A. We'll route chat questions into Typeform quick-capture for leads.

Nina: Confirmed. Typeform fields: name, email, company, question, interest-level (1-5). Submit -> Zapier -> HubSpot -> assign to SDR queue `events-eu`. Can Amanda confirm Zap mapping?

Amanda: Zap mapping done. Extra: include utm_source=rooftop and a boolean `claimed-swag`. Zap creates HubSpot contact + task and appends Google Sheet row for headcount. Ran test at 16:12 — successful.

Ravi: Messaging note for tabletop cards: front headline "Run inference at predictable latency"; back has 2-line bench stat + QR to Typeform. Nina, please sign-off on wording for email/webinar landing.

Nina: Quick tweak: change "predictable" to "predictable, SLA-grade". Also add a one-liner for mid-market teams about Dedicated pools.

Sophie: Speaker situation — Maya (keynote) canceled flight due to weather. Options: (A) fly-in backup speaker (costly, timing risk), (B) run her pre-record + live panel with our PM and a customer, (C) extend demo window and promote hands-on sessions. Preference B. Everyone ok?

Tom: B works. I'll slot a 20-min Q&A after the pre-record. Need panelists confirmed by 17:15.

Ravi: I'll be on the panel for product deep-dive. Can we get a customer on short notice? @CJ any customer contacts in EU?

CJ: Pinged Ola from Nebula; Ola said maybe, pending schedule. If Ola can't, I'll run a live mini-case study.

events-bot: Rooftop venue manager confirmed: 6pm start, indoor backup room reserved at 7:30 if weather. Power access behind table row B. Vendor contact: Pieter +31-20-555-0000.

Sophie: Lead-handling ops: 1) Typeform -> Zapier -> HubSpot assigns to `events-eu` SDRs. 2) Immediate auto-reply email with calendar link for demos (48hr SLA). 3) Follow-up cadence: Day0 auto, Day2 SDR outreach, Day7 product note. Agree?

Amanda: Agree. I'll update HubSpot sequences and ensure calendar link availability for 48hr windows.

Tom: Logistics: table signage (two small A-frames) printed and in office. Banner kit has a missing pole piece — bringing tent clamps as workaround. Who's carrying the banner?

Ravi: I'll bring the banner and bench one-pagers. Also printed 30 postcards with the bench stat for high-value leads.

Nina: Outreach: sending SMS reminder 1hr before to registrants and email with streaming link 30min prior. Also posting event thread in community Slack at 17:20.

Sophie: Final checklist for tonight: pre-record upload 17:00, panelists confirmed 17:15, stream & RTMP check 17:30, swag pivot finalized 18:00, Typeform zap test passed, postcard batch printed 19:00. If customs clears early we'll swap in original tees. Call out blockers now.

Amanda: One blocker: need HS code for tees. Ravi, can you provide product SKU/HS quick?

Ravi: HS code textile 6109.10.00. Sent to shipping docs.

CJ: No more blockers from ops. I'll circulate demo runbook and hotspot password.

Sophie: Thanks team. If anything changes, update this thread. See you tonight :sparkles:
